title: Database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: Timeout waiting for a connection from the pool after 30000ms. FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved / too many clients already. The database itself is up but apps cannot get a connection.
root_cause: The app leaks connections or traffic grew past the pool size, so all connections are busy and new requests wait or fail.
impact: Requests hang then fail with timeouts, even though the database is healthy.
fix_steps: Check active connections: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity.
Restart the leaking app instances to release connections.
Raise pool size or add PgBouncer if traffic really grew.
prevention: Use a connection pooler, set idle timeouts, and alert at 80% pool usage.
